title: Earth's rarity and galactic pyramids
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Earth's rarity and galactic pyramids, about unspecified at Earth; galaxy, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, and they told me that there's there's pyramids all over the galaxy. They're evidently um uh power sources and sources of healing rather than tombs.

plain: Steve Coburn, a man who says he has had contact with non-human beings, says that "they" told him there are pyramids all over the galaxy. According to Coburn, these pyramids are power sources and places of healing rather than tombs, and that Earth is rare among worlds, which, if true, would reframe what pyramids on Earth were for.
